description: This file defines the ForbiddenException class, which is a custom exception used in the OrangeHRM system's API v2. It extends the base PHP Exception class and implements a specific interface for validation errors. The class provides a default error message for unauthorized access.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate forbidden or unauthorized access within the API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new ForbiddenException with an optional custom message, error code, and previous exception.
